notes.notes:

notes.title: Camera Update
notes.notes:
Hi!

Here's an update to the LCK camera and LIV mixed reality app.
When you grab the LCK camera it will now output the video to the monitor and will also start following you around so you can record chase footage and just make it easier to reach the controls.

Press the LCK camera button in the setting to make it stop.

Here's an example of the new follow cam (that drop scared me lol)

[previewyoutube=t333xsBg9pM;full][/previewyoutube]

I've also fixed the LIV mixed reality app so it should composite with camera feed or LIV avatar properly.

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Updated LCK plugin
[*] Updated Normcore plugin
[*] Tweaked the space level a bit
[/list]

notes.title: Best VR game in Steam Next Fest?
notes.notes:
[b]The best VR game in Steam Next Fest?[/b]
According to NinjaGuy VR we are!

[previewyoutube=vw549Wwtj58;full][/previewyoutube]

And who can argue with those dance moves? ːsteamthumbsupː


[b]How did we do in Steam Next Fest?[/b]
We got over 1k wishlists and over 900 demo plays!


[b]How's the game launch going?[/b]
It's going really well!
We are currently at the top of the new and trending category for VR games!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205482/6dd7092b28a9168c4735ad6dcb3ae43b62ddc61a.png[/img]


[b]What's next for Journey Up?[/b]
As you can see from our updates log we're busy fixing bugs and adding requested features.
We're also working on a free content update which will drop in the coming weeks!


Thanks for playing the game and don't forget to leave a review (it really helps us out)

notes.title: Steam Next Fest + Nova Game Expo
notes.notes:
I hope you're all as excited by Steam Next Fest (25 Feb - 4 Mar) as we are!

Journey Up will be participating later this month but if you can't wait we're also exhibiting at the web based Nova Game Expo which runs from February 15th – March 2nd

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205482/56eb7249ca06be81df73e01157459b0691fb60ce.jpg[/img]

Free tickets available here: 
https://giveaways.page/novagameexpo_1214552

You can check out our booth and play a web demo there along with many other indie games in a virtual game expo.


In other game news we've implemented all the suggestions and feedback from the steam community and other forums including auto-run and multiplayer exploits. 

Please keep sending us your thoughts about the game so we can keep polishing it for release!
